audit.whatIsWrong: Every full-layer field naming Hwei's threat ability calls it 'Subject: Fear (CC Paints)'. Hwei has no ability by that name anywhere in his kit (P Signature of the Visionary, Q Subject: Disaster, W Subject: Serenity, E Subject: Torment, R Spiraling Despair).
audit.why: This is the same class of error the calibration set flags (Brand's fake 'Ares of Blaze', Cassiopeia's fake 'Noxious Blight'). His only hard-CC ability per the kit flags is E, Subject: Torment (hardCC + slow, cd 12/11.5/11/10.5/10), so that is what the text should be tracking — the fabricated name currently points a reader at nothing they can find in-game.
audit.corrected: Replaced every instance of 'Subject: Fear (CC Paints)' with the real ability, 'Subject: Torment (E)', across tldr/winCon/enemyWin/breakdown.cooldowns/breakdown.feeding/loading/focus/dosFull/report.

audit.why: Content spikes[] correctly identify the level-2 double-cast poke spike, the level-6 R Spiraling Despair zone, and the first-item Rylai's/Liandry's chip spike — all grounded in real Hwei mechanics (double-cast, no dash, ranged zone control).

audit.whatIsWrong: packet.defects flags: 'level chart contradicts data: Poppy wins 52.2% but the chart gives Hwei 7/7 stages vs 0' — both the full-layer phases[].side (flat 'Skill' template) and content win[] (all 'Hwei') currently show Hwei sweeping every stage, which cannot be true if Poppy wins the matchup 52.2% of the time over 1366 games.
audit.why: I cannot determine from the kits alone which specific stages should flip — Hwei's early/mid range and poke advantage is real and well-documented in the existing prose, but nothing in the kit tells me exactly where late-game tank stats and Keeper's Verdict interrupts should swing it back to a net-positive Poppy winrate. Per the DECIDED chart rule, an unresolvable contradiction should be left alone and reported rather than guessed.
